description: This file defines functions and data structures for managing accounting dimensions and filters within the ERPNext system, including setup, fetching, updating, and copying dimension data.

methods.name: setup_dimension_filters
methods.description: Initializes dimension filters by fetching custom dimensions and setting up filters based on document types.

methods.name: fetch_custom_dimensions
methods.description: Fetches custom accounting dimensions from the server and triggers filter setup.

methods.name: setup_filters
methods.description: Sets up filters for each accounting dimension, including handling child tables and account fields.

methods.name: setup_child_filters
methods.description: Configures filters for child table fields related to dimensions.

methods.name: setup_account_filters
methods.description: Sets up filters for account fields based on dimensions.

methods.name: update_dimension
methods.description: Updates dimension values for new documents, setting defaults based on company and existing data.

methods.name: copy_dimension_from_first_row
methods.description: Copies dimension values from the first row of a table to other rows.
